run_coverage_check: run the sphinx coverage check builder to verify all haiku public symbols are documented
get_public_symbols: get all public haiku symbols by scanning internal python modules and filtering hidden ones
setup_sphinx_extension: setup the haiku coverage check sphinx extension by adding the custom builder to the app
review_HaikuCoverageCheck: review the HaikuCoverageCheck builder class that compares documented objects against public symbols
test_finish_method: test the finish method to detect undocumented symbols and raise a SphinxError if any are missing
